resolved_findings.title: Allow the resume regression fixture to use all available devices
resolved_findings.body: The new resume regression fixes ICI axes to data=1 and model=1. MeshConfig.resolve_mesh_shape requires the configured product to equal devices_per_slice when there is no -1 axis, so every policy/microbatch parameterization fails before model initialization on a multi-device host. Add an absorbing replica axis (for example replica=-1) so the required multi-device CPU and accelerator coverage can reach the behavior under test. The author separately reported CPU4 8 pass / 4 failures at this fixture; no reviewer runtime was executed.
resolved_findings.evidence: Static MeshConfig validation in levanter/utils/mesh.py:121-127; author-reported CPU4 fixture failures.
resolved_findings.resolution: Added parallel_size=2 for device counts divisible by four (otherwise one), an absorbing replica=-1 mesh axis, and train_batch_size=4*device_count//parallel_size. CPU4 resolves data=2/model=2/replica=1 and yields train batch 8 with microbatch size 4, hence two microbatches. The exact reverse response patch reconstructs the prior r2 file SHA; AST delta is confined to these three fixture choices.
